issue_request: FHIR-18367 was a Published/Persuasive STU3 clarification asking that the Defining Extensions cardinality text say an extension with minimum cardinality 0 is 'by default' optional anywhere it appears, avoiding an absolute statement because profiles can override local cardinality.
initial_application: The Jira comment points to GH#afe30cd91d, and commit afe30cd91dda96c805e3ea501b2256f171c48a22 changed source/defining-extensions.html from 'then the extension is optional' to 'then the extension is, by default, optional' on 2018-11-08. That commit is an ancestor of the current branch.
additional_context: source/defining-extensions.html is listed in publish.ini as a built page, and source/fhir.ini maps the Extension type page to the active Extensibility page that links to defining-extensions.html. Zulip and Confluence searches for FHIR-18367 and optionality/cardinality terms found no relevant evidence changing the Jira/source conclusion.
reconciliation: No source change was made because source/defining-extensions.html already says, 'If the Extension minimum cardinality is 0, then the extension is, by default, optional anywhere it appears.'
